sourceChecks.claim: Cloudflare CDN definition verifies geographically distributed cached response assets near users. RFC9111 storage and reuse model distinguishes private/shared caches and policy-controlled response reuse, supporting layer-specific avoided work.

MDN max-age/Age explicitly deducts time spent in earlier caches; s-maxage overrides shared only. RFC9111 Age calculation includes origin generation/validation and residence/transit. Stale retention and freshness arithmetic are supported.

MDN ETag conditional request explicitly returns matching 304 without body. RFC9111 4.3.3-4 verifies updated metadata and reuse versus full changed response; the contact itself does not eliminate application work.

RFC9111 explicitly defines unqualified no-cache/private/no-store, Authorization exceptions and Set-Cookie not inhibiting caching. The lesson correctly adds independent permission enforcement and verified CDN exclusion rather than asserting cookie-derived privacy.

Cloudflare cache keys documents URL/query/header inclusion, ignore-query merging and fragmentation. RFC9111 Vary matching requires nominated header values; provider-specific support caveat prevents generic language-matching guarantees.

Cloudflare purge page lists URL/tag/host/prefix and variant operations. Its edge/browser TTL followup explicitly says purge does not affect browser assets. MDN versioned/hash URLs and immutable cache-busting support asset/reference separation.

RFC5861 defines additional seconds after staleness for background validation and eligible-error fallback, with expiry ending authorization. Given the stated no-conflict/support assumptions, 90/180 endpoints and cold-copy limitation follow directly.

Cloudflare hit ratio defines hits divided by hits+misses; CDN benefits describe nearby delivery and origin transfer reduction. Stated single-layer arithmetic is exact; request versus byte/database measures and conditional fit are appropriate deductions.
